ValidationRule.description: Requires at least one product before an Enterprise Opportunity advances to Propose, Negotiate or Closed Won (Q11, Q15). Bypass: Bypass_Opportunity_Sales_Validation, granted via Sales_Ops_Validation_Bypass.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Sales_Validation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Enterprise", NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Propose"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiate"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), NOT(HasOpportunityLineItem) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Add at least one product before moving this opportunity to Propose.
